fact: A whole-of-government e-payment gateway to be run by the Central Bank of Lesotho is being developed and will soon be integrated with the Lesotho National Single Window, per CAFI's newsletter.
Minister Moorosi says the government is close to launching an integrated online services platform with an electronic payment gateway so citizens can pay for services digitally instead of cash.

Revenue Services Lesotho says taxes can be paid electronically through its e-Payments platform by mobile money (EcoCash, M-Pesa) and by bank EFT, including Standard Lesotho Bank's UNAYO, whose payments show instantly in the RSL system.

Revenue Service Lesotho said it had fully implemented its e-Taxation system after a pilot, covering tax filing and payments for all registered clients, with e-filing and e-payment platforms taught at tax clinics.
Newsday reports that the Revenue Services Lesotho e-Tax platform now enables electronic payments, with the RSL Commissioner General giving the account.
